name: context-gardener-cowork
description: Context hygiene for Cowork and other hosted Claude surfaces, where the context that steers a session is a persistent memory store, a set of account skills and any connected folder rather than a local .claude directory. Runs the seven context-gardener drift checks against that surface, reports findings ranked by how badly each could mislead, stages every fix outside the loaded surface, and applies to the live memory store or a skill definition only on your instruction. Sibling to context-gardener, which covers the Claude Code file surface.
